# Symbiocen

> An interactive regenerative urban design digital twin for exploring whole-life carbon, operational energy, daylight, structures, ecology, materials, and climate-responsive architecture.

Symbiocen is an educational and research prototype. It helps students and multidisciplinary building teams make early-stage trade-offs visible by coupling a parametric 3D building model with transparent, deterministic surrogate simulations and a multi-agent design council.

## Core capabilities

- Parametric regenerative building and urban design exploration
- Whole-life embodied-carbon and biogenic-carbon-storage signals
- Operational energy, photovoltaic yield, and net-zero-readiness indicators
- Daylight autonomy, annual sunlight exposure, and glare-risk signals
- Structural wind-deflection and drift checks
- Green-cover, stormwater-retention, microclimate, and biodiversity indicators
- EC3-inspired material inventory and circularity comparisons
- Architect, engineer, constructor, and ecologist design perspectives

## Responsible use

Symbiocen provides immediate comparative feedback, not certified project analysis. Its surrogate equations do not replace validated whole-building energy models, finite-element analysis, computational fluid dynamics, certified environmental product declarations, code review, or licensed professional judgment.
